yt.title: $100 from {cpi_year} needs to be ${cpi_needed_n} today #Shorts
yt.description:
US consumer prices (CPI-U, seasonally adjusted), {cpi_from} to {cpi_to}. Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED (CPIAUCSL). CPI is an average; your own costs may differ.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: How much is one hundred dollars from the year {cpi_year} worth today?
To buy the same things, you now need about {cpi_needed_say} dollars.

scenes.label: higher consumer prices since {cpi_year}
scenes.narration: That is {cpi_pct_say} percent higher prices, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
If your income did not grow that much, you can buy less. Did yours keep up?
